# prime-splitter

prime-rs: Splitter component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/splitter) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-splitter) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/splitter.md)

Splitter - port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-splitter`.

Panels in a row or column with gutters between them: sizes change by dragging (mouse, touch) and with arrows on the handle.
Panel content is `panels` (instead of `ng-template #panel`). Sizes are stored in percent and rendered as
`flex-basis: calc(<share>% - <(n-1)·gutter_size>px)`; with `state_key` set they are saved in browser storage.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_splitter::Splitter;

let panels = vec![ViewFn::from(|| view! { <p>"One"</p> }), ViewFn::from(|| view! { <p>"Two"</p> })];
let html = view! { <Splitter panels=panels panel_sizes=vec![30.0, 70.0] /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-splitter-horizontal") && html.contains("calc(30% - 4px)") && html.contains("calc(70% - 4px)"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-splitter = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["splitter"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
